title: Blake Conrad
text: My name is Blake Conrad, I am an Industrial Engineering student at the University of Arkansas. As well as this I am in AFROTC as that is my true goal in life. I plan to utilize opportunities within the Air Force to strengthen my abilities in the engineering world. My true goal is to fly however, I feel that industrial engineering will help me understand more about the big “business” of the military world.
